title: Recording: Wino Junko by Wings | 1976
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Peter Henderson

Wings continued work on the Wings At The Speed Of Sound song ‘Wino Junko’ on 13 January 1976.

The band’s drummer Joe English had walked out of the previous day’s session, but returned for this one. The backing track on this day had Paul McCartney on electric piano, Denny Laine on bass guitar, and English on drums.

They recorded 20 takes, numbered 2-21, although only 12 were complete. Take 21 was marked best and became the basis of the album version.
